title: Handover answer
description: The body of the signed 200 answer to a handover, application/json, at most 1 MiB. The answer has one of two forms. The run-key form, when the handover did not set run_code: true, contains run_key and the run's documents: everything else the job needs to run the step, which are domain, inputs, and, as each member says, access, target, work_item, run_settings, stack and workflow. The run-code form, when the handover set run_code: true, contains exactly version, revision, run_id, step and run_code, and no other member: the job redeems the run code and gets the run key and the run's documents in the redemption's signed 201, as run_code describes. With a run code, the starter never receives the run key or the run's domain, inputs, run_settings, stack and workflow: those come only in the redemption's signed 201. The claim answer still gives the starter step, access, target and work_item, claim-answer.schema.json. The starter passes the answer to the job it started for the dispatch alone, and keeps the run key, or the run code, no longer than that. A run key is handed over at most once per run: the control plane sends the answer with Cache-Control: no-store, never gives it again, and once the handover is answered with the signed 200, the dispatch's run never goes back to the queue. For the step prebuild, the run-key form carries no work_item, and its inputs are exactly version and environment_ref, as inputs says. The answer names the contract revision it was built for in revision, inside the signed body: the starter refuses an answer whose revision is not the revision it implements, the one it sent in X-Qory-Contract-Version, as https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json describes for the integration contract. It is signed under the control plane's server key, and the starter checks it under a server key it pinned at enrolment before using it, as https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json describes. The starter refuses a member this schema does not define.

version.description: The document format. The starter refuses a version it does not read.

revision.description: The revision of this contract the control plane built the answer for: 3, the one revision the control plane serves and the one the request's X-Qory-Contract-Version named. The answer's signature covers it, with the rest of the body. The starter refuses an answer whose revision is not the revision it implements.

run_id.description: The run, the run key's run_id.

run_key.description: The run key of the run the handover registered, as handover.schema.json describes: the Forager contract's run key, at most 2048 characters, whose payload is https://qory.dev/contracts/forager/v1/run-key.schema.json. Present in the run-key form, when the handover did not set run_code: true, and absent in the run-code form.

run_code.description: The run code: present in the run-code form, when the handover set run_code: true, and absent in the run-key form. qecr_, 26 upper-case Crockford base32 characters, then the fingerprints of one or two of the control plane's server keys, each a dot and 22 base64url characters. The starter passes the code to the job it started for the dispatch alone. The job redeems the code once, within 15 minutes of the handover, at POST /.well-known/qory-enrolment of the control plane, as https://qory.dev/contracts/forager/v1/enrolment.schema.json describes, and gets in the signed 201 the run key, step and the run's documents, as the run-key form would contain them.

step.description: The step the run is for.

domain.description: The domain of the workspace the run is for, such as software. Required in the run-key form. In the run-code form it is absent, and the job gets it from the redemption's signed 201, as run_code describes.

access.description: What the run may do on its target. Present exactly when target is present. Run-key form only. In the run-code form it is absent, and the job gets it from the redemption's signed 201, as run_code describes.

target.description: Where the run's change would go, and absent when the run has no place where a change would go. The step explore may have none. For the step explore, inputs.target is this target, and is absent when this answer has none, inputs.domain is this answer's domain, and inputs.work_item.id is this answer's work_item.id, as https://qory.dev/contracts/explore/v1/inputs.schema.json states. The step prebuild always has one: the place whose environment the job builds. Run-key form only. In the run-code form it is absent, and the job gets it from the redemption's signed 201, as run_code describes.

work_item.description: The work item the run is for, for the step explore; absent for the step prebuild. A step other than explore or prebuild carries work_item, or leaves it out, as that step's schema says, and the job refuses a step it does not know. Run-key form only. In the run-code form it is absent, and the job gets it from the redemption's signed 201, as run_code describes.

run_settings.description: The runtime and model settings the job composes the agent's harness with. The control plane sends run_settings only for the step explore: an answer of the step prebuild has no run_settings. run_settings contains no key or secret. With no provider chosen, only runtime is present: the run uses the gateway's configured key and the runtime's default model. The control plane guarantees four rules that this schema cannot check: the ids in provider_models are unique; effort is listed for model in provider_models; each tier's model is in provider_models; and a tier's effort is listed for that tier's model in provider_models. The job writes the values as given, and maps no model or effort value to another. The control plane keeps the serialized handover answer within 1 MiB. When the answer with run_settings would exceed it, the control plane drops the oldest comments from inputs and sets comments_omitted, as the 768 KiB rule for inputs does, until the answer fits. Run-key form only. In the run-code form it is absent, and the job gets it from the redemption's signed 201, as run_code describes.

runtime.description: The runtime's name in Forager's runtime descriptor, https://qory.dev/contracts/forager/v1/descriptor.schema.json, such as claude.

model.description: The exact id of the model the run uses.

effort.description: The effort value the run uses with model. Present only with model.

provider_models.description: The models of the run's provider, 1 to 256, each with the effort values it accepts. Present exactly when model is present. When provider_models is absent, the agents run on the provider of the gateway's key, and for a run with a target, the job applies the tier map set at the run's target as written, as on a local run. A run with no target has no such tier map: without provider_models, no tier map applies, and the run uses the runtime's default model. When provider_models is present and the run has a target, an entry of the tier map set at the run's target applies only when its model id is listed in provider_models, and its effort only when that effort is listed for that model.

effort.description: The effort values the model accepts, 1 to 16, each listed once. An entry with no effort means the model takes no effort value.

tiers.description: The tier map the control plane resolved for the run: a model, and optionally an effort value, for each tier it maps. Present only with model. Its only keys are light, fast and thinking. A tier the control plane does not map is absent. For a run with a target, a tier the control plane maps applies instead of the entry for that tier in the tier map set at the run's target, and the tier map set at the run's target fills only the tiers left absent. A run with no target has no such tier map: only the tiers the control plane maps apply.

light.description: The model of the tier light.

fast.description: The model of the tier fast.

thinking.description: The model of the tier thinking.

stack.description: The stack the run starts, which the control plane sets. The job passes it to qory as `-f <url>#<commit>:<path>`. Present exactly when workflow is present, and absent, with workflow, when the run starts no stack. Run-key form only. In the run-code form it is absent, and the job gets it from the redemption's signed 201, as run_code describes.

url.description: The https address the job fetches the stack from, with no query and no fragment.

commit.description: The commit of the stack the job fetches: 40 lower-case hexadecimal digits.

path.description: The folder that contains the stack's qory-stack.yaml, relative to the top of what url fetches: names of letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, separated by slashes, with no .. segment, at most 255 characters.

workflow.description: The workflow of the stack that the run starts, invoked as its command, such as hello, which the job invokes as /hello. Run-key form only. In the run-code form it is absent, and the job gets it from the redemption's signed 201, as run_code describes.

inputs.description: The step's input, which the control plane writes and the job reads; the starter passes it to the job unread. At most 768 KiB serialized. Its shape belongs to the step's schema, not to this contract, so for any step but prebuild this object takes any member beside version: it is the one object of the contract that does. For the step explore, the shape is https://qory.dev/contracts/explore/v1/inputs.schema.json. For the step prebuild, the inputs are exactly version, 1, and environment_ref, and this contract closes them. environment_ref is the environment_ref the prebuild was queued for, as https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json describes it: a newer environment_ref read for the collection while the run waits replaces it, and one read after the claim does not. The job takes the place from this answer's target, builds the head of that place's default line from the fetch it makes, so environment_ref may predate the head it builds, and reports the commit it built and this environment_ref, unchanged, in prebuilt, prebuilt.schema.json. Required in the run-key form. In the run-code form it is absent, and the job gets it from the redemption's signed 201, as run_code describes.

version.description: The version of the step's input, which the step's schema defines.

tier.description: The model of one tier: a model id, or an object of a model id and an optional effort value.

effort.description: The effort value the tier uses with its model.
